publicSupportCandidates.title: Read the comparison result
lines: In a model-supported comparison, a fault that moves with the motor points to the motor side. A fault that stays on the same channel points to that channel's wiring or drive path.
Record the motor, channel and result for each comparison. A passing motor test alone does not identify the driver board as faulty.
publicSupportCandidates.scopeReason: Interprets the already-authorized model-supported isolation; does not add a swap procedure, connector instruction or universal tool capability.

publicSupportCandidates.title: Clean the cutting area safely
lines: With the mower fully powered off, wear protective gloves and use a soft brush or damp cloth to remove debris.
Protect the vision module if the mower must be turned over. Do not use sharp objects on the chassis or rinse the mower with water while it is upside down.
publicSupportCandidates.scopeReason: General non-invasive official maintenance detail applied only to the existing powered-off debris-removal action. Not a disassembly or motor replacement procedure.

publicSupportCandidates.title: Compare charging under the same conditions
lines: A normal adapter reading with no mower connected does not prove that the charging source works under load. Retain the station indicator and charging-state observations when the mower docks.
For each comparison, record which adapter and station were used and the charging result. Change only one component at a time.
publicSupportCandidates.scopeReason: No voltage threshold, live-probing procedure or battery diagnosis. Extends existing controlled charging comparison.

publicSupportCandidates.title: Record the station-side result
lines: Record station power/indicator status and whether the mower recognizes each tested station-and-adapter combination.
Keep the model and firmware unchanged while comparing compatible hardware; a combined swap cannot identify the failed component.
publicSupportCandidates.scopeReason: Result recording for the existing station-side comparison only.

publicSupportCandidates.title: Clean contacts and the IR window
lines: Fully power off the mower before cleaning. Use a soft brush or damp cloth on the charging contacts and charging-station IR window.
Avoid sharp objects and corrosive or volatile solvents. Retain the docking behavior after cleaning for the next check.
publicSupportCandidates.scopeReason: Non-invasive cleaning method for the already-authorized action; no electrical cleaning under power prescribed.

publicSupportCandidates.title: Describe when power is lost
lines: Record whether the mower never powers on, starts then shuts down, or powers off when leaving the station. Include the indicator state and battery readings from the supported test.
If heat, swelling, an unusual smell, water ingress or sparking is present, stop further powered tests and contact PIE.
publicSupportCandidates.scopeReason: Observation and current safety stop; no battery-opening or voltage instructions.

publicSupportCandidates.title: Separate station power from mower positioning
lines: Record the RTK station's power and indicator status separately from the mower's RTK connection/positioning status.
Retain visible antenna damage, water ingress or installation obstruction for PIE. A mower positioning symptom alone does not confirm that the RTK station is faulty.
publicSupportCandidates.scopeReason: Only the existing RTK-station path; does not add GNSS Antenna Check or assume physical RTK is used by another positioning variant.

publicSupportCandidates.title: Read the bumper cross-check
lines: If the suspect bumper works on a confirmed-good compatible reference mower, retain that result for PIE to investigate the mower-side sensing path.
Do not label a replacement bumper as proven good merely because it is new. Confirm STOP and bumper operation during final safety checks.
publicSupportCandidates.scopeReason: Interpretation of an existing authorized compatible cross-check; sealed chassis-side Hall replacement remains PIE-only.

publicSupportCandidates.title: Confirm the replacement reference
lines: Match the damaged cable's function and connector endpoints to the exact model's SBOM and service diagram before choosing a part.
An alternative-part listing does not establish model compatibility. If the diagram, SBOM or compatibility table disagree, retain the conflicting references and ask PIE before fitting the part.
publicSupportCandidates.scopeReason: Adds lookup interpretation only; no SKU, routing, pinout or disassembly inferred.

visibleMandatoryAllRepairs: Complete the model-applicable Functional Test, Communication Check and Auto Map Run; retain all three complete passing reports and a Connect Checking screenshot.
After final testing, upload a fresh log and retain the successful upload record.
Unsupported, unrun, missing or failed applicable tests are not a pass; contact PIE when final verification cannot be completed.
verificationRecommendations.conditionalBurnIn: After a driver-board, motor, battery or power-component repair, complete the supported Burn-in test and retain a passing result. Replacing only the charging station or charging contacts does not require Burn-in.

cardRecommendations.burnIn: Required after the authorized confirmed motor or driver-board repair; not presumed completed by standard tests.
Required after cutting-motor repair; do not imply debris cleaning alone requires it.
Required for power-component repair, conditional on actual repair; station/charging-contact replacement explicitly exempt.
Required after battery or power-component repair; no universal Battery Test/Burn-in coverage claim.
Same power-component condition; station/charging-contact replacement explicitly exempt.
Not required for cleaning or station/contact-only replacement.
Do not infer tool applicability to RTK itself; PIE confirms supported acceptance if a power-component repair was performed.
No blanket Burn-in addition for bumper repair; standard safety/functional verification applies.
Conditional only if the actual repaired cable belongs to a power/driver/motor repair; the generic visible-damage symptom does not establish that.
